comments.body:
## Cross-note from a453 RCA (/rebar-debug Phase 1)

Root-caused the shared tickets-store growth driver on `defensive-buckskin-rhino` a453. Summary relevant to this data-disk alarm:

**Shared driver:** a ~10× step-change surge in `tickets`-branch commits from **2026-08-21** (~120K commits — over half the 235,260-commit branch — in 8 days), dominated (88% of non-merge events) by the **enrichment quartet** (ENQUEUE/CLAIM/DONE_ENRICH + TICKET_DIGEST), fanned ~4–5× per ticket edit + 27K auto-reconcile merges, all permanently retained (no causal-stability GC; compaction only renames to `.retired`). 1,239 tickets re-enriched ~15×.

**Where 5a05 DIFFERS from a453:** a453's CI metric is a **blobless** pack (~90% trees, 0 blobs). This **on-disk** store is **larger and blob-inclusive** — it also carries f9ee's ~235 MB comment-echo blob bloat + `.bridge_state` churn + working-tree/`.retired` retained files that the blobless CI pack excludes. So the data-disk growth = **the same commit/tree surge PLUS the blob mass**.

**Timing:** the acute 08-26 climb to 88% is ~5 days after the 08-21 surge — consistent with sustained fill crossing the alarm threshold. A possible **independent component** (Gerrit review artifacts / server-side packs sharing this volume) is plausible but **unverifiable read-only**; not chased (root-disk pressure is separate/resolved).

**Remediation** (handed back, not implemented): bound enrichment fan-out (`apparent-sighted-cockatoo` 4520 — prevents future growth), reclaim retained history (`polite-antivirus-bedbug` 536b causal-stability GC or a one-time rewrite like `censual-organic-mouflon` — the only directions that *shrink* on-disk mass), footprint budget (`epidemic-chocolaty-imago` 0754). Full RCA + ranked directions on a453.

comments.body:
## STOPGAP RECLAIM performed — /var/gerrit data disk relieved; alarm cleared to OK (ticket left OPEN)

Authorized operator reclaim (human: "Approved for 1a"). This buys disk headroom only; it is **NOT** the root-cause fix. Ticket intentionally left **in_progress / OPEN** — the durable fix is 4520 (bound enrichment fan-out) + 536b (causal-stability GC / one-time rewrite), with 0754 (footprint budget), handled elsewhere.

### Runbook followed
**No data-disk reclaim runbook exists.** `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md` covers only the **ROOT** volume (`rebar-root-disk-pressure`, docker cache prunes) — nothing for the `/var/gerrit` **data** volume. GAP: a `/var/gerrit` reclaim/headroom runbook should be added (ties to the AC "add a guard/headroom or growth alarm"). Proceeded conservatively per the ticket's own remediation AC.

### Access
SSM RunShellScript (non-interactive) to `i-00880b2c7f13527c5` / us-east-1 (per review-bot-ops box coordinates). No interactive session, no Gerrit stop, no history rewrite.

### Inspection (du breakdown — satisfies AC "identify what consumed /var/gerrit")
`/var/gerrit` = 50G, **47G used / 3.0G avail / 95%** before. Top consumers:
- `/var/gerrit/site/retired-ticket-clones/` = **30G** ← two **superseded, self-contained divergent whole-store clones**:
  - `reviewbot-tickets-divergent-376bc29e` (28G, ec2-user, mtime 08-26 19:53)
  - `reviewbot-tickets-live-divergent-59f2fd14` (2.1G, root, mtime 08-27 03:24)
  These are review-bot `tickets` clones parked aside when the store diverged from `origin/tickets` before the ensure-tickets hard-reset (`infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh` L124/L147) during the 08-26/27 remediation.
- `/var/gerrit/rebar-quiet-window-evidence/` = 11G (two 08-26 epoch-probe evidence dirs) — **left untouched** (incident evidence).
- `/var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets` 2.6G, `reviewbot-tickets` 2.2G — **LIVE stores, untouched**.
- Live Gerrit repo `/var/gerrit/site/git/rebar.git` is only **475M** (already well-packed) — so the on-disk bloat is **not** in the served repo's packs; an online `git gc`/repack would reclaim negligibly. Repack deliberately **skipped** to minimize mutations on the prod Gerrit repo.

### Safety checks before deletion (all passed)
- No live store references the retired clones via git **alternates** (no `objects/info/alternates` under `/var/gerrit/site` points into them; the retired clones are themselves self-contained).
- No open file handles (`lsof +D` / `fuser` clean).
- Live `site/reviewbot-tickets` store is a separate, healthy, mounted volume (verified present post-delete); the retired clones are derivative of `origin/tickets` and re-clonable.

### Action (exact commands, as root via SSM)
```
df -h /var/gerrit                                   # BEFORE: 47G used / 3.0G avail / 95%
rm -rf /var/gerrit/site/retired-ticket-clones/reviewbot-tickets-divergent-376bc29e
rm -rf /var/gerrit/site/retired-ticket-clones/reviewbot-tickets-live-divergent-59f2fd14
sync
df -h /var/gerrit                                   # AFTER: 18G used / 33G avail / 36%
```
No `git gc`/repack run; no `--force`; no history rewrite; no live store touched; the 11G evidence dir preserved.

### Result — before/after
| | Used | Avail | Use% |
|---|---|---|---|
| BEFORE | 47G | 3.0G | **95%** |
| AFTER  | 18G | 33G  | **36%** |

**Reclaimed ≈ 29G.** `/var/gerrit` now 36%, far below the 85% threshold.

### Verification (satisfies AC "reclaim so alarm clears" + "reviewbot healthy")
- CloudWatch `rebar-gerrit-data-disk-high`: **ALARM → OK** at 2026-08-29T13:35:32 PDT. Fresh datapoint `disk_used_percent`(mount=/var/gerrit)=**36.0** at 13:30 PDT (95→36 step). StateReason: "1 datapoint [36.0] was not >= threshold (85.0)."
- Containers all **healthy**: `compose-gerrit-1`, `compose-review-bot-1`, `rebar-mcp-*`, `compose-opcert-1` all Up. Gerrit HTTP `/config/server/version` → **200**. Live `reviewbot-tickets/.git` intact.
- Metric publisher (`observability.sh`, ~5-min timer) confirmed republishing post-reclaim.

### Stopgap disclaimer / what remains
This reclaimed **incident byproducts** (retired divergent clones), NOT the growth driver. The `tickets`-branch commit/tree surge + blob mass will refill the volume over time. **Durable fix = 4520 (bound fan-out) + 536b (causal-stability GC), plus 0754 (footprint budget).** Remaining ACs still open: `reviewbot_healthy` steady-state confirmation over time, and the **data-disk growth/headroom guard** (none exists — a data-volume alarm/runbook is the follow-up). **Leaving 5a05 OPEN.**

compiled_state.description:
# /var/gerrit data disk filled and has stayed near-full; review-bot went unhealthy

## Impact (stated first)
The Gerrit/review-bot box (`i-00880b2c7f13527c5`, region us-east-1) suffered a box-wide
disk-fill starting **2026-08-26 ~15:00 PDT**. The `/var/gerrit` data disk jumped from a
~55–59% baseline to **93–95% within ~6h and has NOT recovered** — it is still **94%** and the
alarm `rebar-gerrit-data-disk-high` is **still in ALARM** at the time of this sweep
(2026-08-29 10:00 PDT). During the fill, `rebar/host:reviewbot_healthy` **dropped to 0**
(unhealthy) for two multi-hour windows, so LLM-Review capacity was degraded. Gerrit itself
stayed up (`gerrit_healthy`=1, `Rebar/Gate:GerritReachable`=1 throughout).

## Evidence — CloudWatch (namespace rebar/host, InstanceId i-00880b2c7f13527c5)

### `rebar-gerrit-data-disk-high` alarm
- `describe-alarm-history`: **OK -> ALARM at 2026-08-26T17:55:32 PDT**; no return-to-OK since.
- StateReason: "1 datapoint [88.0 (27/08/26 00:50Z)] >= threshold (85.0)".

### `disk_used_percent` mount=/var/gerrit (Maximum/hour, PDT)
- Baseline: 52% (08-25 17:00) rising slowly to 59% (08-26 14:00).
- **Sharp climb**: 08-26 15:00 = 64% -> 16:00 = 81% -> 17:00 = **88%** -> 18:00-20:00 = 89% ->
  21:00 = **93%**.
- **Plateau, unrecovered**: 93-95% continuously from 08-26 21:00 through 08-29 10:00
  (latest datapoint **94%**). Trend: plateaued high, not draining.

### `reviewbot_healthy` (Min/hour = 0 means unhealthy) — service impact
- **0** for 08-26 15:00,16:00,17:00,18:00,20:00,21:00 PDT (coincides with the data-disk climb).
- **0** again for 08-28 16:00-20:00 PDT (coincides with the root-disk thrash + deploy backpressure below).

### Correlated root-disk pressure on the same box (30-GiB gp3 root, `root_disk_used_percent`)
- `rebar-root-disk-pressure` **flapped into ALARM ~18 times** 08-26 20:41 -> 08-28 10:45 PDT.
- Root usage oscillated 76-**98%** (peaks: 98% @08-26 15:00, 98% @08-28 01:00), then relaxed
  to ~72-82% after 08-28 11:00.
- `disk_pressure_prunes` ran **continuously ~5-6/hour for ~24h** (08-27 10:00 -> 08-28 10:00 PDT)
  — the automated reclaim was working overtime and the root disk still sat near-full, matching
  the "reclaim frees nothing" symptom of the closed root-disk tickets.

### Downstream backpressure (08-28 16:00-20:00 PDT, review-bot unhealthy again)
- `deploy_errors`: Sum=1 at 08-28 16:00 and 17:00 PDT -> `rebar-autodeploy-errors` ALARM
  17:07->17:47 PDT.
- `review_interrupts_bound_exceeded`: 08-28 16:00, 18:00, 19:00 (alarm flapped 3x);
  `review_interrupts_signal_unavailable`: 08-28 17:00 (alarm 17:07->17:22).
- `deploy_deferrals` climbed to Max 19-20/period on 08-28 evening — autodeploy repeatedly
  deferred, consistent with disk pressure + in-flight reviews.
  (Caveat: some marker-delta counters can over-report on a cold-start republish per closed
  bug e2a6 widespread-zealous-narwhal; but the co-timed `reviewbot_healthy`=0 and root-disk
  peaks make a real backpressure episode the stronger reading.)

## Likely common cause (hypothesis)
A large repository/pack growth landed on the box around 08-26 15:00 PDT, filling both
`/var/gerrit` and root simultaneously. This is corroborated by CI's repo-growth guard tripping
the same day: `.github/workflows/verify-identity.yml` step **"Fail closed if the blobless
checkout pack exceeds its limit"** (`REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB`, git `size-pack`), plus the
mirror pack-size limits. Candidate on-disk consumers to confirm on the box: git repo/pack
growth under `/var/gerrit` (tickets-branch and mirrors), Gerrit review artifacts/caches,
docker layers/build cache, and journald/logs.

## What this ticket is NOT (dedup)
- No existing ticket covers the **`/var/gerrit` data disk** mount; all prior disk tickets are
  the **root** volume or docker cache (3a52 masonic-abeyant-stagbeetle, 9bc0
  taurine-smiling-hamadryad, 7a41 forgivable-nerdy-genet — all closed). The data-disk high +
  sustained-non-recovery is a distinct, currently-active condition.
- The 08-28 root-disk flapping recurs the closed root-disk-pressure symptom (3a52); linked
  relates_to for context rather than as this ticket's headline.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Identify what consumed `/var/gerrit` on 08-26 (du breakdown on the box: git/packs vs
      review artifacts vs docker vs logs) and confirm/deny the pack-growth hypothesis.
- [ ] Reclaim or grow `/var/gerrit` so `disk_used_percent` returns below the 85% threshold and
      `rebar-gerrit-data-disk-high` clears (operator action — READ-ONLY sweep did not remediate).
- [ ] Confirm `reviewbot_healthy` returns to steady 1 and stays there.
- [ ] Add a guard/headroom or growth alarm so a repeat pack-growth event does not silently sit
      at 93-95% for days (portable: not tied to a single CI provider).

## Constraints / notes
- Filed by a READ-ONLY AWS ops sweep (window 2026-08-26T17:55 PDT -> 2026-08-29T10:00 PDT). No
  AWS mutation performed. Remediation (disk cleanup / volume resize) is an operator action.
- Box logs are NOT shipped to CloudWatch Logs in us-east-1 (only lmn-*/snap-* groups exist), so
  on-box `du`/journald inspection is required to finish root-cause — see sweep blind-spot note.
